  • FAQ's

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's
What services do you offer?

We provide end-to-end event management services, including event planning, venue sourcing, décor, stage setup, audio-visual production, entertainment, artist management, catering coordination, logistics, branding, and on-site event execution.

Do you provide complete event planning or only specific services?

We offer both. You can choose complete event management or hire us for specific services such as décor, production, entertainment, venue management, or event coordination.

Which locations do you serve?

We are based in Bengaluru and execute events in all the major cities in India, as well as other countries, depending on the project requirements.

Can you manage last-minute events?

Depending on the scope and availability, we can execute urgent projects. Contact us as early as possible, and we'll do our best to accommodate your requirements.

Can you work within my budget?

Yes. We believe every event can be customised to suit your budget while maintaining quality and delivering a memorable experience.
